svg.title: Who Uses Which Microsoft AI Product
svg.desc: Two audiences. Business users use three products: Microsoft 365 Copilot (AI in Word, Excel, Teams and Outlook), Microsoft Copilot (free, Bing-based, consumer; no access to org data) and Copilot Studio (build custom copilots and agents). Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio connect to Microsoft Graph, your organisation's data connector. Developers and IT professionals use Microsoft Foundry to build enterprise AI, which in turn uses Azure AI Search and Azure Vision in Foundry Tools.
svg.text: Who Uses Which Microsoft AI Product
Business users work in Copilot products; developers and IT build on Microsoft Foundry.
